# Three refused logins on one connection, each classified differently:
# a temporary failure, a NO with only an alert, rejected credentials.
S: * OK [CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 AUTH=PLAIN] ready
C: A1 LOGIN "user@example.com" "app-password"
S: A1 NO [UNAVAILABLE] Temporary authentication failure.
C: A2 LOGIN "user@example.com" "app-password"
S: A2 NO [ALERT] Please log in via your web browser
C: A3 LOGIN "user@example.com" "app-password"
S: A3 NO [AUTHENTICATIONFAILED] Invalid credentials (Failure)
